newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Yukong to invest 100 bln won in oil exploration.
newsitem.headline: Yukong to invest 100 bln won in oil exploration.

text.p: Yukong Ltd, South Korea's largest oil refiner, said on Wednesday it would invest 100 billion won in overseas oil exploration this year, compared with 45.3 billion won last year.
A company statement said the investment would go to both new and existing oil exploration projects.
Yukong earned a total of 66.3 billion won in oil exploration last year, up 27 percent from 52.1 billion in 1995, it said.
The refiner has been participating in 19 fields in nine countries, including oil producing blocks in Marib oil field in northeast Yemen, northern Peru and Egypt.
Yukong announced late February that its 1996 net profit shrunk significantly to 68.21 billion won from 103.20 billion in 1995 due to a huge foreign exchange translation loss.
